text:
jordan: noticed a bunch of GPU nodes spinning but not joining the cluster, autoscaler says 'attach-security-group failed'. GPUs are idle and cost is climbing. Anyone touched node pool IAM or SGs?
ops-bot: :rotating_light: Incident created: #INC-2026-472 — node-provisioning-security-group-fail (linked ticket)
maria: that was me — merged #1893 this morning to tighten node role permissions (removing some ec2:* privileges). I thought it only affected legacy pools, hmm.
lucy: can we attach SG manually to get nodes healthy while we fix role? quick AWS CLI: 
```
aws ec2 modify-instance-attribute --instance-id i-0abcd1234 --groups sg-0a1b2c3d
```
or attach to ENI: 
```
aws ec2 assign-private-ip-addresses --network-interface-id eni-0abc --allow-reassignment
```
ana: checking CloudTrail + audit logs — I see AssumeRole for the instance-profile succeeded but there are repeated AccessDenied errors for ec2:ModifyInstanceAttribute and ec2:AssociateSecurityGroup. Also seeing CloudTrail delivery logs recently encrypted with a rotated KMS key (key-id: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:key/aa11bb). If CloudTrail delivery role lost decrypt permissions the audit pipeline shows gaps which confused some bootstrap checks.
oncall-sam: short plan — 1) roll back #1893 to restore ec2:AssociateSecurityGroup to node role, 2) fix KMS key policy so CloudTrail delivery role and SRE audit role can read logs (allow: kms:Decrypt, kms:GenerateDataKey*), 3) warm nodes and re-run health checks. Rollback will be fastest to stop immediate cost bleed.
maria: rolling back now, pushing hotfix PR that re-adds a narrowly scoped ec2:AssociateSecurityGroup and an inline condition limiting SG ARNs. PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/infra/pulls/1902 — will deploy in 5m.
jordan: thanks — seeing kubelet connect logs starting to pop up, pods scheduling on GPU nodes again. I'll keep an eye on cost dashboard. :thumbsup:
ana: after the rollback we should run a policy audit and add an automated test that simulates node boot to catch missing EC2 permissions + verify CloudTrail KMS decrypt for delivery-role. I can add a small harness.
ops-bot: Incident #INC-2026-472 updated: status -> mitigated, assigned -> maria
maria: leaving a follow-up ticket to rotate KMS key policy safely and a postmortem note in /docs/incidents/ — will include terraform snippet for the least-priv policy.
jordan: closing thread here, GPUs warming and autoscaler back to normal. Thanks all.
